purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: lecture discussion; vocabulary (極めて/ゆえ/果たし/意志/ないし) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 責任を果たすのは、極めて大事ですね。
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 責任ゆえに、人は成長します。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 意志が弱いと、果たせませんか?
lines.en: With weak will, can't we fulfill it?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 意志を、少しずつ鍛えればいいのです。
lines.en: You can train your will little by little.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一人、ないし仲間と、進むんですね。
lines.en: We advance alone or with companions.
lines.style: understanding young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 極めて難しい時こそ、意志が問われます。
lines.en: Especially in extremely hard times, will is tested.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 役目を、必ず果たしたいです。
lines.en: I definitely want to fulfill my duty.
lines.style: resolved young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 意志あるゆえに、君は果たせますよ。
lines.en: Because you have will, you can fulfill it.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
